766540101.text: Well, I think we can now say that the Grand Library is complete. Next, we'll need to find somewhere to put the bird stands, cushions, and deposit boxes...

766540103.text: Thanks to your help, the library repairs are basically complete. It's really starting to look the part.

766540104.text: What about that other stuff you just mentioned? Are you planning on putting all that in the library too?

766540105.text: Yes. That said, it's too big of a job for me to handle alone. I was planning on getting some of our more skilled artisans to help out.

766540108.text: The Grand Library is open to humans and animals alike. Since we have furniture for humans to sit down on, there should naturally be some for the animals too.

766540109.text: Huh, yeah... That does kinda make sense...
